reconstruction_notes.en: Nominal scale, palette, posture, simplified counts and fine relief are artistic. Original geometry only; no exact species/specimen, microscopic, locality, salinity or coexistence restoration. Cobbania mounts at the freshwater waterline with roots below it.

name.zh: 受 Aysheaia 启发的粗短有爪叶足动物

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish corrugated soft trunk on stout stub legs with terminal claw clusters in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以横皱软躯干下为粗短足，足端具爪簇搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。
